purpose: Teach: セッティング/余剰/履行/教委/当人/民放/窃盗/終値

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会議室のセッティングを早めに済ませましょう
lines.en: Let's get the meeting room set up early.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient opening. Business-like but not cold. Assumes agreement. Forward momentum without urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期は余剰人員の再配置を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll proceed with redeploying the surplus staff this quarter.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgement, slightly formal register. Quiet confidence in the task at hand. No flourish, just competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約の履行状況を月次で報告しましょう
lines.en: Let's report on contract compliance monthly.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. Thoughtful pause before the instruction — this is important but not alarming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元教委との連携プロジェクトを企画中です
lines.en: Understood. I'm currently planning a partnership project with the local education board.
lines.style: Factual update, slightly more detail than expected. Quieter than the direction — giving information, not orders. Professional but genuine.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様当人ご来店時の応対マニュアルを整えましょう
lines.en: Let's finalize a customer reception manual for when clients visit in person.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'finalize' — this matters for the company face. Steady eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。民放各局への広報を準備しております
lines.en: Understood. I'm preparing public relations outreach to the major broadcast networks.
lines.style: Calm report. Slightly longer form — he's being thorough. Professional register, no apology in the tone. Work in progress, stated with confidence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内、窃盗防止カメラを増設しましょう
lines.en: Let's install additional security cameras throughout the office.
lines.style: Direct instruction, practical matter-of-fact. No defensiveness despite the security implication. Brisk, efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終値ベースで配当を計算します
lines.en: Understood. I'll calculate the dividend based on closing price.
lines.style: Final acknowledgement. Slight firmness on 'closing price' — the specificity matters. Professional closure, ready to move forward.
